name: launch_specialist
description: Launch a specialist subagent. Pass the specialist skill id. Do not implement the work in the parent and do not load the full grill-spec-tdd-xfn-release lifecycle unless the request is a new feature. When a prior phase exists, pass the handover path. When model class is asserted for TDD after spec COMPLETE, pass class implement.

specialist.description: Specialist skill id such as agent-review, agent-debug, or agent-tdd

handover.description: Path to the relevant handover when the specialist needs prior phase output

class.description: Model class for the specialist when asserted. After spec COMPLETE, TDD is implement unless BLOCKED or a new architectural fork.
